As a Service Delivery Employee in Venlo, you work for a large logistics provider. You work 40 hours a week. You are the contact person for clients and carriers, both in the Netherlands and internationally. In this role, you have a lot of client contact, spot bottlenecks, and come up with solutions. You make sure everything runs according to agreements and keep clients satisfied. This makes the job varied and challenging.
Your day starts with checking ongoing transports. You create reports and monitor the goods flow. You solve problems quickly, for example in case of damage or delays. You work with a transport management system (TMS), keep records, and make sure all customs documents are correct. You think about how processes can be improved and share your ideas with the team.
This job is perfect for you if you like variety and working with people. You work independently but also help colleagues when needed. You get room to grow, learn new things, and develop your talents. Apply today if you’re ready for a new step! 🚀

- Bachelor’s degree working and thinking level, preferably in transport or logistics

- 1 to 5 years of relevant work experience

- Knowledge of international transport, logistics, customs regulations, and import & export

- Experience with logistics administrative tasks

- Good communication skills in Dutch and English

- You are accurate, stress-resistant, and solution-oriented

- You work independently and enjoy working in a team

- Good knowledge of Outlook, Excel, and TMS

- Experience with BlueRock is a plus

Woo-hoo! Your new warehouse job in the kitchen factory is here! Start working full-time as a warehouse worker. Get a nice salary of € 17,99 per hour. Apply now and start your new job by DKG in Bergen op Zoom even next week! 💸

What we offer
- Salary of € 17,99 per hour (incl shift allowances)
- Always work fulltime in 3 shifts!
- Travel allowance of € 0,23 per kilometer
- Lots of career opportunities: grow further!
- Get a permanent contract quickly!
- Big muscles and big money! 💪

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse worker:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You are available for 4 to 5 days.
- You are available to work in 3 shifts.
- You have your own transport to get to Bergen op Zoom.
- You are strong enough to lift kitchen cabinets all day

What will you do
Together with your team you load and unload containers every day. You check where all the kitchen cabinets and boxes full of screws need to go! You slide them onto the conveyor belt. After that you stack everything in the trucks. You make sure everything arrives at the right place. Now that’s a lot of variety as a warehouse worker. And so active! 💪

You’re the last and most important step in the whole process. Saving the best for last! Is there a department that hasn't finished their work yet? That means you’ll have to stay a bit longer too. Working overtime is no punishment here by the way. Because DKG will provide free snacks and drinks! Free snacks and more money. Win-win, right?! 🤩

You will work full-time in sort of 3 shifts. Check out your working times 👇
Day shift: 06:00-14:15 or 08:00-16:15
Afternoon shift: 14:10-22:25 or 16:00-00:15
Late afternoon: 18:00-02:15

Where will you work
At DKG you know you're in the right place. The atmosphere is awesome. Your future colleagues are happy to welcome you to the warehouse! You’ll feel right at home from day one. From ice creams on hot days to food and drinks when working over

Your Responsibilities

Operating a forklift for the majority of your working day 
Assisting with incoming goods and stock handling.
Loading and unloading company trucks.
Transporting products safely and efficiently within the warehouse.
Maintaining order, cleanliness, and safety in and around the warehouse.
Ensuring work is carried out accurately and according to procedures.
What We Are Looking For

Valid forklift certificate.
Proven forklift driving experience.
Warehouse experience is an advantage.
Good communication skills in English or Dutch.
A proactive and reliable attitude.
Ability to work with speed and accuracy.
Willingness to work in a chilled environment (8degrees).
